exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mooncake < authored.jsonl'
stdout '"format":"mooncake-jsonl-v1"'
stdout '"timestamp":1000.5'
stdout '"outputTokens":0'
exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mooncake -output sessions -execution-policy serial-recorded -path /chat/completions -protocol openai-chat -model fixture < authored.jsonl'
stdout 'source arrival/delay not scheduled'
stdout '"body":\{"max_tokens":8,"messages"'
stdout '"sourceRow":1'
! exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format bailian -output sessions -execution-policy serial-recorded -path /chat/completions -protocol json < counts.jsonl'
stderr 'count/cache-only'
! stdout .
! exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mooncake -output sessions < authored.jsonl'
stderr 'explicit serial-recorded'
! exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mystery < authored.jsonl'
stderr 'unsupported format'

exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mooncake -block-size 4 < authored.jsonl'
stdout '"blockSize":4'
! exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mooncake -block-size 0 < authored.jsonl'
stderr 'block size must be'
! stdout .
! exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mooncake -block-size true < authored.jsonl'
stderr 'invalid value'
! exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mooncake -block-size 1.5 < authored.jsonl'
stderr 'invalid value'
! exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format mooncake -block-size 1000001 < authored.jsonl'
stderr 'block size must be'
! exec sh -c '"$CLI" -format bailian -block-size 4 < counts.jsonl'
stderr 'unsupported for bailian'
